decisions.why: the single Ointment Applicator sits in Sheffmed's reusable/single-use ENT instrument catalogue alongside Jobson Horne probes, wax hooks and specula, all of which are already mapped to ent:instr; it is an aural/nasal ointment applicator instrument, not a pharmacy item

Variable Cannula (Black) follows the same colour/gauge naming as this supplier's already-mapped '2 Piece Suction' division (Suction Controller Tip 22G Black, 20G Yellow, 18G Pink), so it is an ENT variable-suction cannula; black is not a colour in the standard IV cannula gauge code, which rules out a peripheral IV cannula reading
